note: This file contains ONLY @triton.jit GPU kernel functions. They are not directly callable Python functions — they must be launched via Triton grid configuration from wrapper modules (node_to_edge_wigner_permute.py, permute_wigner_inv_edge_to_node.py, custom_ops.py). No simple CLI usage is possible for these kernels directly.
review_node_to_edge_wigner_permute_kerne: review the triton jit kernel node_to_edge_wigner_permute_kernel for forward gather wigner rotation and L to M permutation
review_node_to_edge_wigner_permute_bwd_d: review the triton jit kernel node_to_edge_wigner_permute_bwd_dx_kernel for backward gradient computation with respect to input x
review_permute_wigner_inv_edge_to_node_k: review the triton jit kernel permute_wigner_inv_edge_to_node_kernel for forward M to L permutation and wigner inverse rotation
review_permute_wigner_inv_edge_to_node_b: review the triton jit kernel permute_wigner_inv_edge_to_node_bwd_dx_kernel for backward w transpose dy and L to M permutation
review the triton jit kernel permute_wigner_inv_edge_to_node_bwd_dw_kernel for backward gradient computation with respect to wigner matrices
